SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_method WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL)) AS total_auth_methods,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_method WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_enabled = true AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL)) AS enabled_auth_methods,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_password_policy WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL)) AS total_password_policies,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_password_policy WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_enabled = true AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL)) AS enabled_password_policies,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_online_device WHERE status = 'online' AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL)) AS online_device_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_login_log WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL) AND login_time >= #{startTime} AND login_time <= #{endTime}) AS today_login_success_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_login_log WHERE status = 'FAIL' AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL) AND login_time >= #{startTime} AND login_time <= #{endTime}) AS today_login_fail_count

SELECT COALESCE(login_method, 'UNKNOWN') AS login_method, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_login_log WHERE (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL) AND login_time >= #{startTime} AND login_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY login_method ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE(login_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS login_date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAIL') AS fail_count FROM sys_login_log WHERE (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL) AND login_time >= #{startTime} AND login_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(login_time) ORDER BY login_date DESC
